app_name: Any window from your Mac, on your iPhone and iPad

differentiation.justification: It has 2,328 GitHub stars versus 14,112 for VNC, but offers unique touch‑friendly streaming and a WebSocket GUI, giving it a clear advantage in usability.

performance.justification: Benchmark shows import time of 0.8 ms and a latency ratio of 0.792 versus VNC, suggesting it is faster than traditional VNC solutions.

hn_sentiment.justification: Users praise the app as a smoother, touch‑friendly VNC replacement and highlight its open‑source nature, while several comments point out Sidecar restrictions (no VPN, same Apple ID) and the lack of Windows support, with a few comments raising spam concerns.

summary: This CLI streams macOS windows to iPhone and iPad screens using a WebSocket‑based GUI, enabling remote viewing without an API key. It builds on the familiar remote‑desktop paradigm but adds touch‑friendly interaction and a lightweight Swift implementation. It is suited for macOS power users who need quick, mobile access to their desktop windows, especially on Apple devices. Its main strength is the low latency (0.8 ms import time and 0.792 × VNC latency) while its limited test coverage and early‑stage maturity are notable drawbacks.
